title: VisaGenie: AI-Powered Transparency for Global Migration
subtitle: AI · Transparency

overview.label: Story
overview.heading: Overview
overview.body: AI-powered transparency platform that simplifies complex global immigration workflows through intelligent UX and conversational interfaces.

problem.label: Problem
problem.heading: Why this needed to exist
problem.body: Global immigration is opaque — fragmented rules, forms, and timelines create anxiety and errors.

approach.label: Approach
approach.heading: How the work got done
approach.body: Designed an intelligent UX layer with conversational guidance that translates complex visa logic into clear, stepwise transparency. Anchored to verified sources.

outcomes.label: Outcomes
outcomes.heading: What changed once it shipped
outcomes.body: Simplified comprehension of global migration steps; users complete workflows with confidence and fewer drop-offs.

credits.label: Credits
credits.heading: One last thing
credits.body: AI-powered transparency platform that simplifies complex global immigration workflows through intelligent UX and conversational interfaces.
